title: OpenTelemetry Collector resiliency
read_scope: sending queue, persistent storage, loss circumstances, recommendations
finding: Queue/retry and durable file storage are separate choices; timeout, capacity and disk limits can still lose data.
application: Current Linux journal cursor advances only after event POSTs succeed; dedicated spool capacity/retention and prolonged outage are still unverified.
redistribution: link and brief analysis only; original document not redistributed

title: OpenTelemetry Collector internal telemetry
read_scope: Collector monitoring: queue length, receive failures, data flow
finding: Collector own health, received data, exporter failure and queue state require separate observations.
application: Inventory/process/network/os report separate state, server receive time, last-success and bounded count. Service active is not delivery success.
redistribution: link and brief analysis only; original document not redistributed

title: Fluent Bit 4.2 backpressure
read_scope: memory and filesystem buffering; input pause/resume; limits
finding: Backpressure and input pause/resume depend on configured buffers and limits.
application: A 500-item cap or partial scan must not mean full reconciliation. Source-scoped complete reports alone may remove unseen rows.
